test_title: PYST 3: SSC CPO - Reasoning (Held on: 11 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure that will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae747c37fd7cc2c211cc9d0f8bed71bc8480a0ad2a0f856a577db11d9149ed88.png]
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

**The circle stays on the left side.**

**A new alphabet (descending order) is introduced in each step and moves anticlockwise.**

**The triangle moves right to left.**

Next step:

**The circle will be on the left side, the triangle will be on the right.**

**The alphabet will be 'V' and it will be at top right.**

Now we consider the given options:

Option 1) Positions of triangle and circle is incorrect.

Option 2) The pattern is completely wrong.

Option 3) The pattern is correct.

Option 4) The position of alphabet is incorrect.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3)**
